source: BMTC GTFS feed maintained by Vonter (github.com/Vonter/bmtc-gtfs), feed version 2026-11-09; listed in the Mobility Database catalog
note: Community GTFS feed (unofficial) converted for offline use. Stop points merged by name within 350 m, as in the Delhi dataset. Distances are measured along the feed's published route shape where one exists, otherwise straight-line between stops. Departures shown are the feed's own published timetable. The feed publishes no usable fare table, so fares are not shown.
